resources.string: Logs will start appearing here after you start using the app

First, you need to find a cable to connect your device to the Nintendo Switch. For proper work, this should be a cable that is designed for data transmission, not just for charging.\n\nIt is advisable to use an A-to-C cable and a USB OTG adapter.

You can add your payload from the device\'s memory (click the + button), download it via a direct link (click the button with the cloud icon) on the Payloads screen or simply move it to the Rekado folder (/sdcard/Android/data/com.pavelrekun.rekado/files/).\n\nYou can also use one of the bundled payloads - Fusee & Hekate.
Enter your Nintendo Switch into RCM mode in any convenient way. \n\nYour Nintendo Switch will power on by itself when plugged in, be sure to hold VOLUME +.
Connect the device to the Nintendo Switch and allow permission for the USB access, if necessary. Wait unit payloads chooser dialog will be opened and select which one you want to load.
